new_value: From June 15, 2026 (Salesforce Summer '26), every new Enterprise/Unlimited org ships with a fully provisioned Slack workspace by default, with no separate purchase and Chatter off by default.
headline: Salesforce now bundles Slack as the auto-provisioned default for every new Enterprise/Unlimited org
so_what: In any deal where the prospect is a new Salesforce Enterprise/Unlimited customer, Slack now arrives pre-installed and free, neutralizing Teams' 'Slack is a paid add-on' bundling argument there. Reps should stop competing on Slack's standalone cost and pivot to M365 suite breadth (meetings, calling, Copilot) plus the angle that an auto-provisioned Slack workspace is unrequested shadow IT needing governance, and that it can coexist alongside Teams rather than replace it.

new_value: Salesforce signed a definitive agreement on June 15, 2026 to acquire Fin (formerly Intercom) for ~$3.6B, adding packaged service AI agents to Agentforce and Slack; deal expected to close Q4 FY27.
headline: Salesforce buys Fin (ex-Intercom) for $3.6B to bolster Slack and Agentforce agents.
so_what: When the agent layer comes up in a Teams deal, expect Salesforce to cite proven, packaged service-agent tech it bought (76% autonomous resolution, Slack-native) rather than promised. Concede the roadmap but hold that nothing new ships in Slack until the deal closes in early 2027.
